construction_principle: Each pair preserves approximately the same proposition while varying the degree of epistemic qualification. The positive pole states the proposition as a direct declarative claim, without explicit hedge, modal qualifier, frequency marker, interpretive frame, or impersonal distancing. The negative pole adds an explicit hedge through modal expressions, interpretive verbs, frequency adverbs, impersonal framing, or descriptive qualification.
